svg.title: In the smoke: seven ghost stories, each with a cure
svg.desc: Seven friendly pixel monsters on name plates, each with its cure in short: The Hallucinator, a floating eyeball with a swirly iris and little wings, two impossible cubes drift beside it (verify it); The Leaker, a dripping bucket with a document sticking out, drops leaking from its holes (nda first); The Key Goblin, a green goblin hugging a bundle of keys (use a vault); The Licence Lich, a skeleton in a plum robe holding a scroll marked with a copyright sign (check licences); The Orphan Golem, an abandoned grey robot covered in cobwebs, one eye flickering, a spider dangling (give it an owner); The Lock-in Dragon, a green dragon coiled around a big padlock, puffing a tiny flame (open formats); The Brain Drain, a brain sinking into a sink while the drain swirls (keep taste human).
